predictions.rationale: Central class that defines the Sequence Diagram type itself; matches feature description of diagram showing object interactions over time.
Provides the graph/data model behind Sequence Diagrams, directly supporting their behaviour and contents.
Implements creation mode for messages between lifelines, a key interaction element displayed along the time axis.
Graphical figure that renders a Message in the Sequence Diagram, directly tied to interaction representation.
Figure for the lifeline/object box (classifier role) across the horizontal axis, essential to sequence diagrams.
Draws activation bars along the vertical (time) dimension, visualizing object activity during interactions.
Represents the head of a lifeline (object symbol) which anchors the horizontal dimension of the Sequence Diagram.
Specialised figure for curved/async message lines; supports rendering of varied interaction flows over time.
Handles user interaction/selection on lifeline figures, refining editing behaviour of sequence diagrams.
Explorer rule linking an Interaction to its Messages, providing navigation support related to sequence diagrams.
